text: Invite landing page: add the planned 'Redeem in browser' link
relates: T-43 — the browser-redeem link only works end-to-end for logged-out invitees once the web login flow preserves the intended destination.

Done in e2bd7ea. invite.html valid-token branch now shows "Redeem in your browser"
-> /redeem?token={{token}} (url-encoded), gated on the web client actually being
served — landing.py checks `"web_index" in current_app.view_functions` (its SPA
catch-all), so the link never 404s when serve_web_client=False or web_dist is
absent. Tests: link present with the default (web-served) app, absent when
create_blueprint(serve_web_client=False). Works end-to-end with T-43 (logged-out
desktop user clicks the link -> /login preserves it -> back to /redeem after login).
